parts.t: Welcome to Crescendo! Built by Isle Of Mann in 2019, this top floor 2 bdrm / 2 full bath offers vaulted ceilings and a spacious layout! Completed with premium S/S appliances, quartz countertops, and shaker cabinets w/soft close doors this unit is great for entertaining and sure to impress! Located steps away from Nicomekl River & minutes away from Crescent Beach, Semiahmoo, HWY 99 & all your shops & schools, this unit could not be more conveniently located! Call today to book your private showing!
